title: Tibik teleport catalog
description: Authoring schema for assets/teleport/catalog.json. Drives editor autocomplete + validation; the mod ignores it. See generate_teleport_catalog.cmake (build-time) and teleport_catalog_store.cpp (runtime OTA) for the consumers.

$schema.description: Editor schema pointer; not read by the mod.

schema.description: Optional catalog format version read by the runtime loader.

realms.description: Top-level realms. A destination joins its realm by matching realm name.

destinations.description: Teleportable levels, each belonging to a realm.

farmTag.description: Farm behaviour tag. A destination's effective tags are the union of its own and its realm's. empty = hard-excluded from farming; risky = excluded unless the Advanced toggle is on; the rest are metadata only.

name.description: Join key only (matched against destination.realm); never displayed - use loc_key.

loc_key.description: Mod locale key for the display name (e.g. world.realm.dawn). Must exist in strings/en.json or the build fails.

realm.description: Name of the owning realm (must match a realms[].name).

level.description: Canonical level string the runtime groups by.

loc_key.description: Mod locale key for the display name. Must exist in strings/en.json.

kind.description: portal = inter-level transition (loc_key reuses the target realm's key); poi = named point of interest (its own world.poi.* key).

loc_key.description: Sole display name for both kinds. Must exist in strings/en.json.

pos.description: Absolute world position [x, y, z], fed verbatim.
